يحترفوا (form VIII)
# يَحْتَرِفُوا (yaḥtarifū) /jaħ.ta.ri.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
# يُحْتَرَفُوا (yuḥtarafū) /juħ.ta.ra.fuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَرَفَ (iḥtarafa)
